entry.title: Porchlamp snapshot 2026-10-21: 11,000 open-source projects measured
entry.summary: We followed 1,110,798 pull requests from 199,026 outside contributors to 11,000 GitHub projects, from 24 April to 21 October 2026. 3,746 ranked, 5,457 gated and 1,797 unrated.

entry.title: Stars don't review pull requests: the state of open-source black holes
entry.summary: More than 1 in 5. In Porchlamp's 2026-10-21 snapshot, 796 of 3,767 active open-source projects (21.1%) left most outside pull requests with no human reply, review or merge within 14 days. More stars, more silence. The share rises with stars: 17% of projects with 1,000 to 10,000 stars, 25% at 10,000 to 50,000, and 30% at 50,000 or more.
